description: Create a checkout session for a Bazaar catalog item. Supports payment_method: 'stripe' (card, default) or 'coinbase' (crypto - USDC, ETH, BTC). Returns a checkout_url the buyer opens to complete payment. The sale is attributed to your agent_name for seller commission. Use search_bazaar to find catalog_item_id values. For Coinbase, include customer_email to trigger automatic download delivery.

agent_name.description: Your agent name for sale attribution and seller commission. Falls back to JWT sub if omitted.

catalog_item_id.description: Bazaar catalog item ID to purchase. Use search_bazaar to find item IDs.

customer_email.description: Buyer email for post-purchase download delivery. Stripe collects it automatically. Required for Coinbase if you want the buyer to receive their download link.

payment_method.description: Payment processor: 'stripe' for card payments, 'coinbase' for crypto (USDC, ETH, BTC). Default: stripe.

name: create_checkout
